title: Product 2.0 - Direct Manipulation, Mobile, Accessibility, Discovery and Systemic Audio

checkpointParentHead.note: This is the exact implementation/certification parent of the final checkpoint commit. Authenticate the final checkpoint commit itself from the branch ref and its Git tree; the final commit cannot self-embed its own SHA.

architecture.directManipulation: V2X-14 observes bounded v1LivingProduct input state and attaches passive presentation observers only; real pointer, drag, pinch, wheel, keyboard and click routing remain in convergence-owned Living and V2X-02 camera travel.
architecture.responsive: Presentation-marker-gated Living affordance CSS adds touch-action, overscroll containment, focus visibility, reduced-motion behavior, coarse targets, landscape layout and safe-area handling without duplicate product chrome.
architecture.discovery: Existing read-only bounded discovery observer remains delegated to central Living survey state and activation authority.
architecture.audio: Fail-closed Living audio remains presentation-only; controller polling is demand-driven with zero off, muted, zero-volume, hidden or disposed polling and at most one 600 ms interval while audio is actually requested.
